Class_Skill_Desc_Surecast: Spells can be cast without interruption.</br>Additional Effect: Nullifies most knockback and draw-in effects</br>Duration: 6s
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery: Grants the effect of One with Nature upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery II: Resets the recast timer for Tempered Release upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery III: Resets the recast timer for Borrow upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Beastmastery: Increases the potency of Smash Axe to 160 and Shield Charge to 300.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Borrow: Grants Lingering Vantage upon using Borrow.</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Rally: Reduces Rally recast time to 90 seconds.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Rallying Cheer: Reduces Rallying Cheer recast time to 90 seconds.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Shield Charge: Allows the accumulation of charges for consecutive uses of Shield Charge.</br>Maximum Charges: 3
Class_Trait_Desc_Instinctual Mastery: Upgrades Avalanche Axe to Brutal Rage, Mistral Axe to Hawkish Talons, Spinning Axe to Risen Fall, and Gale Axe to Calamity upon accumulating 250 TP.
Class_Trait_Desc_Tempered Release Master: Grants Lingering Vantage upon using Tempered Release.</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart: Allows for TP Gauge accumulation upon landing certain weaponskill combos.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart II: Allows for Familiar TP Gauge accumulation upon the landing of auto-attacks or Aetheric Burst.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart III: Grants 1 stack of Mastered Instinct upon completing a combo with a beastmaster instinctual skill.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart IV: Grants 1 stack of Natural Instinct upon completing a combo with a familiar instinctual skill.
